name: cacerts
description: Contract test for GET /cacerts (RF-27): a fleet of 20 agents each fetches the manager's CA PEM 10 times over the HTTPS listener. Every request must be answered 200 with an application/x-pem-file body carrying a CERTIFICATE block -- the trust-bootstrap property a real fleet relies on before it verifies anything -- with no transport errors. The route is unauthenticated and body-less, so this doubles as the floor of the listener's fixed per-request cost (TLS + routing, no downstream). A 404 here means the manager has no remote.https.ca_certificate file; a 503 means the configured CA does not sign the listener's certificate and the manager refused to hand it out (both fail the verdict deliberately).
